claims.claim_ar: حصر وقصر المعنى بواسطة أداة الحصر «إِلَّا» في تركيب «مَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوا»، فيُظهر أن ما صدر عنهم لم يكن إلا هذا الدعاء وحده.
claims.claim_en: Use of the exception particle 'illa' (حصر/limitation): in 'mā kāna qawlahum illā an qālū' the particle limits the meaning so that their speech is shown to be only the prayer that follows.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Focuses attention and removes ambiguity: restricts the interpretation to that single utterance (the prayer), excluding other possible statements or accusations.

claims.claim_ar: التفات بلاغي من سرد خبري إلى نقل قول مباشر ودعاء مخاطَب («قَالُوا رَبَّنَا اغفرْ لَنَا...»)، مما يخلق حيوية وإيحاءً بالمشهد.
claims.claim_en: Iltifat (shift of address): the verse moves from reporting ('their saying') to quoting their direct supplication ('Rabbana ...'), creating immediacy and vividness.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited source describes the verse as a divine rejoinder/argument quoting the delegation, which supports a shift into direct speech, but it does not explicitly use the technical term 'التفات' — this is an interpretive inference.
